title: Playing at the Astoria
summary: Punch says he led the first band at the Astoria in 1923-24 and had left Jack Kerr to form his own six-piece band.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you about when the Astoria opened. Do you know when it opened?

I'm the first guy that played up there. First band. I played up there when I did that. I remember two chairs and a little room. Before they built the garden. And they had to build a garden while I was there and they were on top. You had some kid points. The first band I ever played up there. How big a place was it? It was big after the, you know that building they got there now? Oh that was it. Oh that was it. Nice up there man.
How big was your band when you started? Six pieces. And what year was that?
That must have been twenty-four. Twenty-four. Twenty-three, twenty-four.
So you'd been in town a while huh? Yeah, I come from the Army in nineteen nineteen.
And you know, pretty much Jack Kerr and then the boys made me quit Jack and we made up a band and put money in. That's how I got to get up there. God Beans was crazy about me you know.
